label: Jasmine post-harvest products
about: Fresh Madurai Malli (GI-tagged jasmine) for distant markets, travel-ready garlands, jasmine concrete for perfumers, and jasmine-scented tea, from the Madurai flower belt where gluts and spoilage waste much of the harvest.

questions.ask: Which jasmine products do you want to start with?
Insulated boxes of fresh flowers, travel garland packs, bottled extract, or tea pouches?
Will you run your own packhouse or extraction unit, or use a contract processor at first?
Who will you sell to first?
How many kilograms a month do you expect to sell in the first year?

formats.box_fresh: Insulated boxes of fresh buds with gel ice
formats.garland_pack: Garlands and strings packed for travel

jasmine_fresh.label: Fresh jasmine buds, top grade (Madurai Malli)
jasmine_fresh.sourcing: Growers and commission agents at the Mattuthavani flower market in Madurai; prices swing from about ₹100 to over ₹2,000 a kg with festivals and season, so contract a price band with growers or an FPO

jasmine_extract.label: Jasmine flowers for extraction (lower grade, same day)
jasmine_extract.sourcing: Unsold or lower-grade flowers from the same growers, picked up the same morning; extraction needs flowers within hours of picking

hexane.label: Food-grade hexane (solvent; most is recovered)
hexane.sourcing: Licensed solvent dealers; storage above set limits needs a petroleum licence

jasmine_scenting.label: Jasmine buds for tea scenting (bought and used the same day)
jasmine_scenting.sourcing: Same growers; open buds on the scenting day, no cold chain needed

green_tea.label: Green tea leaf (Nilgiris)
green_tea.sourcing: Nilgiris estates and auction buyers; ask for a pesticide-residue report

fresh_export.label: Fresh jasmine buds for distant markets

cheaper_option.note: better solvent recovery and fresher flowers
cheaper_option.trade_off: needs a tighter pick-to-extract window and a better condenser

recipe_note: Starting figures for trials, not tested processes. Jasmine concrete yields are often quoted near 0.25–0.3% of flower weight; measure yours, because flower freshness and solvent recovery decide your cost.

costing_defaults.format_lever: Send lower grades to extraction and tea scenting instead of selling them off cheap in a glut
costing_defaults.label: Example figures for a first estimate. Replace with your own quotes; nothing here is a market price.

regulatory.title: Madurai Malli GI authorised user
regulatory.text: To sell under the Madurai Malli geographical indication, register as an authorised user with the Geographical Indications Registry.

regulatory.title: Phytosanitary certificate for fresh-flower export
regulatory.text: Each export consignment of fresh flowers needs a phytosanitary certificate from the Plant Quarantine authority, meeting the importing country's rules.

regulatory.title: APEDA registration (RCMC)
regulatory.text: Floriculture exports register with APEDA, which also runs export assistance schemes.

regulatory.title: Solvent storage licence
regulatory.text: Storing hexane above the exempt quantity needs a licence under the Petroleum Rules (PESO).

regulatory.title: Cosmetics licence for finished products
regulatory.text: Concrete sold to perfumers is a raw material; finished perfume, attar or hair oil made by you needs a cosmetics manufacturing licence.

regulatory.title: FSSAI registration or licence by turnover (jasmine tea)
regulatory.text: Basic registration up to ₹12 lakh annual turnover; State licence above that (up to ₹20 crore); Central licence above. Apply on FoSCoS.

templates.title: Choose the jasmine line and its buyer
deliverables: {n_variants} products chosen
Which are fresh, which are extracts, which are food
Who buys: flower importers, temples and events, perfumers, tea buyers
templates.why: Fresh flowers, extracts and tea need different equipment, licences and buyers.

templates.title: Secure flowers through the season
deliverables: Agreements with 5+ growers or an FPO near Madurai
Price band for peak, festival and glut months
Grading rules: what goes fresh, what goes to extraction or tea
templates.why: Jasmine prices can swing tenfold within weeks; a price band and grading plan keep your cost predictable.

templates.title: Freshness trials: how long buds last at each step
deliverables: Hours of shelf life at picking, packing, transit and delivery
Cooling and packing method that keeps buds closed

deliverables.text: Garland packing that survives a day of travel
Extraction trials: pick-to-extract hours, concrete yield per kg of flowers, solvent recovery
Tea scenting trials: rounds of scenting, aroma after 3 months

templates.why: Freshness and yield decide what you can sell, how far, and at what cost.

templates.title: Talk to buyers before you scale
deliverables: 10+ buyer conversations per product
Sample shipments to 3 buyers
Prices and volumes they would commit to
templates.why: Importers and perfumers buy on samples and specifications, not on promises.

templates.title: Cost every kg using your measured losses
deliverables: Cost sheet per product with your grading losses and quotes
Landed price for each buyer, including freight
Cost-cutting levers chosen
templates.why: Losses in grading and transit change the price more than anything else.

templates.title: GI, export and product licences
deliverables: Madurai Malli GI authorised-user registration

deliverables.text: APEDA registration and a phytosanitary process with a clearing agent
Solvent storage licence check and fire safety for the extraction unit
FSSAI {fssai_tier} and food labels for the tea

templates.why: The GI tag is your strongest selling point, and exports cannot leave without the right papers.

templates.title: Cold chain and dispatch
deliverables: Packhouse with pre-cooling near the flower market
Insulated boxes and gel ice
Airport cargo slots booked for the evening flights
A delivery partner at the destination
templates.why: Fresh jasmine has hours, not days; the cold chain is the product.

templates.title: Set up or contract extraction
deliverables: Extractor and solvent recovery, own or contracted
Yield and quality records for each batch
Specification sheet for perfumers
templates.why: Perfumers buy on a specification; consistent yield and quality are what they pay for.
